import pyautogui, time
time.sleep(0.5)
# Click at the start of line 2
pyautogui.click(200, 176)
time.sleep(0.2)
# Shift-click at the start of line 10 to select through line 10
pyautogui.keyDown('shift')
pyautogui.click(200, 304)
pyautogui.keyUp('shift')
time.sleep(0.2)
# Press Tab to indent the selection
pyautogui.press('tab')

import pyautogui, time
time.sleep(0.5)
# Extend selection to include line 10
pyautogui.keyDown('shift')
pyautogui.press('down')
pyautogui.keyUp('shift')
time.sleep(0.2)
# Indent the newly selected line
pyautogui.press('tab')
